column1: # Nudi and Baraha ANSI glyph table.
# The format is described in src/legacy/table.rs.
# The codes were identified from the Nudi 01 e font file by rendering each glyph
# and matching it against the Unicode Nudi font shaped with HarfBuzz, then checked
# against typed letter charts and Karnataka government pages from 2002.
# The preferences match how typists stored these glyphs on 35 Karnataka government
# pages from 2002, archived by the Internet Archive under kar.nic.in/rdpr/kan-www/
# and kar.nic.in/finance/bud2002-kan/: 9,047 words, counted per glyph sequence.
# Consonants drawn without the head stroke
# Consonants built from 2 or 3 glyphs: ಮ from ವ, ಯ from ಂ, ಝ from ರ
# Mahaprana mark: turns ಪ ಬ ಡ ದ into ಫ ಭ ಢ ಧ
# Vowel signs. C0 is the head stroke for the inherent a.
# Spacing glyphs with no text value
# Punctuation drawn as itself or as Indic punctuation
